y-m-68-06.material:
Two students find derivative of f(x)=x^x (x>0). (Read: x to power x.)
Student A: "Exponent na x, so for (x^n)′=n·x^(n−1), put x where n dey, giving f′(x)=x·x^(x−1)=x^x."
Student B: "Take natural log both sides: ln f=x·ln x. Differentiating gives f′/f=ln x+1, so f′(x)=x^x·(ln x+1)."
To check which right, calculator give average rate of change at x=1, (f(1.001)−f(1))/0.001, around 1.0010.
